title: 屋外宅配ロッカー
description: 大小12個の扉と側面端末、雨よけ屋根を備えた屋外宅配ロッカー。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Outdoor parcel locker bank with twelve differently sized doors, gasket seams, flush pulls, a side terminal and a drip canopy. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
